name: Scheduler bug (missed / wrong next run)
signal: Duplicate JobEntity key with a past run time repeating every ~7.5 min; next-run line vs UI.
residual: Time zone missing from next-run line (timezone variant invisible).

name: Tenant limits reached
signal: failed to create entity … + LimitExceededException ('license has expired' / limit).

name: Export failure
signal: failed to generate CSV|XLSX … (poller timeout / poll request failed); publish to …-csv failed; completion email failed.
residual: Row-limit (10k) rejection not logged.

name: Geo-blocking
signal: Interaction error url or seed final URL on out-of-country / unavailable page.

name: Redirect loop
signal: net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS on the page.

name: Seed unreachable / soft-404 / error-page redirect
signal: DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL on seed; high 404 share; final url …/404|/500.

name: Analysis engine crash / limit
signal: failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES with stack trace (page URL).
residual: Worker-side ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR (ENOENT) must be split off as Evinced-side.

name: Pipeline dispatch / state-machine failure
signal: Pair 'Failing URL set … due to job timeout/failure' + 'Failed running create crawl request' for one property after a scheduler tick; k8s BackoffLimitExceeded.
residual: Underlying cause of 'job timeout/failure' not logged.

name: Rate limiting (HTTP 429)
signal: Per-job status histogram: 429 share ≥ 10% (front-loaded & decaying = throttle; sustained = hard limit).
residual: Rate-based WAF rules that answer 403 in waves look like A1.

name: Bot challenge page (Cloudflare / reCAPTCHA)
signal: Per-job histogram: 202 share ≥ 30% from the first minute (bot-manager interstitial).
residual: Cloudflare challenge returns 403 → identical to A1 (#3420).

name: WAF / firewall hard block
signal: 403/405 share > 60% of the SCAN's page results (crawl statuses alone over-count: SE review 2026-11-10 found 2 runs at 76–91% crawl share that were 'blocked but not for the majority of pages', and a 58% run was unclear); onset at request 1–3 (deny list) vs after N 200s never recovering (reputation trip); OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT share ≥ 80% at a flat plateau (tarpit). Exclude internal tenants (Evinced Demo Account). Validated: 11 of 12 customer runs were real issues.
residual: vs A2-Cloudflare, vs A4 when the flag is on but wrong IPs allowlisted.

name: Static egress IP not enabled
signal: admin-server request body useStaticIp=false for the job (id = k8s job name) or job on a non '*-pool-stat*' node pool, combined with a block that has per-page statuses (fast-tier crawls log none and must be excluded). Use as a tag on the A1 alert. SE review 2026-11-10: 4 of 4 real; fix = allowlist or a customer header.
residual: Flag on but customer allowlisted other IPs: egress IP not logged.

name: Outdated browser user agent blocked
signal: Blocked job whose config dump user agent is Chrome/65 or HeadlessChrome.
residual: An old UA does not change the block's shape; confirmed only by a re-run with a current UA.

name: Heavy page load timeout
signal: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT share ≤ 10%, 200s continue to the end, the same URLs fail in every run.
residual: Shares between 10% and 80% stay ambiguous with A1/A5.

name: Login / interaction selector mismatch
signal: Interaction error 'No element found for selector: X' with error.url = login page, AND no 403/405 resource error on the login request; 'is not a valid selector' = malformed.
residual: exists:true is unreliable; vs B4 on identifier-first IdPs.

name: Stale / invalid credentials
signal: All login steps run, 'finished interacting with page successfully', but the browser is still on the login route ~20 s later on every request.
residual: SPA MFA screens sharing the login route look the same (B1).

name: Session lost mid-crawl
signal: Per pod (browser session): first request logs in OK, later requests of the same pod keep landing on the login URL while other pods succeed.
residual: With one pod there is no sibling to compare; per-URL bounces = gated pages (C4).

name: MFA / 2FA blocks login
signal: Request that clicked submit ends on a path with mfa|otp|2fa|verify|challenge (path only, not query string).
residual: Rule defined but no live case found in 7 days; SPA MFA on the same route is invisible.

name: Multi-step / custom login flow needs configuration
signal: Partial step sequence: username typed, then the Continue/next step fails on the identity provider — AND the job ends with 0 pages visited (or every login attempt in the job fails). SE review 2026-11-10: 3 of 5 runs that matched the step pattern but still visited pages were retries that recovered (no issue); the 2 real cases were selector/timeout problems.
residual: Cannot separate 'element missing' from 'element not yet rendered' (needs DOM/screenshot); 300000 ms cap is not specific; real cases overlap B2.

name: Redirect target outside the domain whitelist
signal: Seed final URL rejected as 'final url not included in whitelist' AND its host is NOT in the job's 'allowed domains: {…}' line.

name: Include regex matches nothing / invalid regex
signal: Same rejection text but the host IS in 'allowed domains' (regex/path rejected); or 'language is not included in whitelist' on every URL.
residual: The include regex itself is not logged in a safe line.

name: Scope too broad / unexpected URLs
signal: Huge crawl with > 90% of fetched URLs rejected by the exclude list after fetching; page cap 'max visits reached'.

name: List-mode misconfiguration
signal: failed to create entity … 'No URLs were supplied' / 'URL set not defined'; 'max visits reached' with visited = 1 (cap set to 1).

name: Platform outage / infra incident
signal: Distinct tenants with FAILED / dispatch failures per hour ≥ ~5, or a collapse in worker log volume.
residual: Threshold calibrated on one quiet week and one outage.

name: Backend query error / timeout ('Error loading scan')
signal: front-server 5xx with request_uri joined by operation_id to 'invocation of function … took > 10 s' or NotFound (deleted scan).
residual: 502/504 returned by the gateway is not logged.

name: UI bug / UI confusion
signal: Same join as E5 but with a product exception (NullPointerException etc.).
residual: Pure front-end bugs and UI confusion never reach the server.

name: Grouping / URL-normalization rules
signal: Only rejects are 'sanitized url was already visited' on #fragment URLs (SPA routes collapsed).
residual: Other grouping problems leave only page counts.

name: Incomplete render → findings variance
signal: 'Execution context was destroyed' on the page (navigation during analysis).
residual: Most D3 tickets are findings that vary with render timing — not logged.

name: Integration issue (Jira / ADO / MCP)
signal: MCP: 'invalid request caller ID: MCP'.
residual: Jira / Azure DevOps calls are not logged in these services.

name: Soft block (block page with HTTP 200)
residual: Block page served with 200: no title, body size or link count logged — identical to C6.

name: Non-link (JS) navigation
residual: Seed 200, no links followed, nothing filtered — identical to A3 / A2-with-200.

name: TLS / SSL certificate error
residual: Browser ignores certificate errors; nothing logged.

name: Export count semantics
residual: Export semantics, not a failure.

name: Confirmed engine false positive
residual: Findings accuracy is in scan results, not logs.

name: Disputed finding: true positive
residual: Same as G1.

name: Score / severity / WCAG configuration
residual: Score/severity config; engine version change is the only hint.

name: Suppression / masking request
residual: Request, not a failure.

name: Access & licence
residual: Account/permission requests (licence expiry is E4).

name: Access setup questions (IPs / headers)
residual: Questions.

name: Config / admin task
residual: Admin tasks.

name: Feature request / how-to
residual: Feature requests / how-to.

name: Out of scope / noise
residual: Noise / out of scope.
